description: This file defines utilities for handling IP address families (IPv4 and IPv6), including functions to determine if IPs or CIDRs are dual-stack, and to identify IP family types.

methods.name: IsDualStackIPs
methods.description: Checks if a list of net.IP addresses contains at least one IPv4 and one IPv6 address, and all are valid.

methods.name: IsDualStackIPStrings
methods.description: Checks if a list of IP address strings can be parsed into valid IPs and contains at least one IPv4 and one IPv6.

methods.name: IsDualStackCIDRs
methods.description: Checks if a list of CIDRs contains at least one IPv4 and one IPv6 CIDR, and all are non-nil.

methods.name: IsDualStackCIDRStrings
methods.description: Parses CIDR strings and checks if the resulting CIDRs include at least one IPv4 and one IPv6.

methods.name: IPFamilyOf
methods.description: Determines the IP family (IPv4, IPv6, or unknown) of a net.IP address.

methods.name: IPFamilyOfString
methods.description: Determines the IP family of an IP address string.

methods.name: IPFamilyOfCIDR
methods.description: Determines the IP family of a CIDR.

methods.name: IPFamilyOfCIDRString
methods.description: Determines the IP family of a CIDR string.

methods.name: IsIPv6
methods.description: Returns true if the net.IP is IPv6.

methods.name: IsIPv6String
methods.description: Returns true if the string contains a single IPv6 address.

methods.name: IsIPv6CIDR
methods.description: Returns true if the CIDR is a valid IPv6 CIDR.

methods.name: IsIPv6CIDRString
methods.description: Returns true if the string contains a single IPv6 CIDR.

methods.name: IsIPv4
methods.description: Returns true if the net.IP is IPv4.

methods.name: IsIPv4String
methods.description: Returns true if the string contains a single IPv4 address.

methods.name: IsIPv4CIDR
methods.description: Returns true if the CIDR is a valid IPv4 CIDR.

methods.name: IsIPv4CIDRString
methods.description: Returns true if the string contains a single IPv4 CIDR.
